void traverse(long long valA, long long valB, int idxA, int idxB) {
    long long diff = abs(valA - valB);

            bestVal = valA;
        }
        return;

    if (idxA >= rows) {

        long long sumB = comb[idxB][rows];
        traverse(valA, valB + deltaA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB);

    if (idxB >= rows) {
        long long sumA = comb[idxA][rows];
        long long deltaB = comb[idxB][rows] - comb[idxB - 1][rows];
        traverse(valA + sumA * deltaB, valB, idxA, idxB - 1);
    }
}

int prefixA[12345], prefixB[12345];
unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;

long long compute(long long valA, long long valB, int idxA, int idxB) {
    long long key = valA * 10000 + idxA * 100 + idxB;

        long long sumB = comb[idxB][rows];
        result += compute(valA, valB + deltaA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB);
    }
    if (ch != 'A') {
        long long sumA = comb[idxA][rows];
        long long deltaB = comb[idxB][rows] - comb[idxB - 1][rows];
        result += compute(valA + sumA * deltaB, valB, idxA, idxB - 1);
